change_summary: Preserve an explicit current user same-work or containment relationship as the common Work Model ancestor while Corvio uses source evidence to design independently maintained branches beneath it.

canonical_skill.note: The Workspace Skill distinguishes weak same-batch continuity from an explicit same-work or containment relationship, preserving the latter as common-ancestor authority without precomputing Corvio's internal tree.

server_contract.note: The server advertises Skill release 1.7.68 and collaboration contract 2026-09-17.7 and carries the same relationship-authority ordering into the Host contract.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.68; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports Skill 1.7.68; its compact correction guidance remains compatible while the full Skill carries the common-ancestor boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness records that explicit same-work identity governs the common ancestor while source evidence governs factual and independently maintained leaves; runtime remains non-semantic.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Prompt, Mission, source-manifest, Host Skill, backend contract, and package tests assert the relationship-authority order plus separate-root counter-boundary.
